title: Fleur De Lis | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, Fleur de Lis unfolds into a cozy yet luxurious haven with its three inviting bedrooms, each thoughtfully appointed to ensure restful nights. The home boasts beautiful pickled wood floors and updated designer furniture, blending comfort with elegance. The heart of the cottage features a recently updated kitchen that opens up to a spacious living and dining area, making it an ideal gathering space for families. The upstairs sanctuary includes a king master bedroom with a private modern bath, a queen bedroom, and a third bedroom designed for younger guests, alongside a bonus living area that promises memorable family moments, from board games to movie nights. With its prime location, generous accommodations, and serene outdoor spaces, Fleur de Lis offers an unparalleled Seaside escape for families seeking both relaxation and adventure. The management fees for your booking include access for all members of your party throughout your stay to utilize the facilities of the Seaside Swim and Tennis Club and Fitness Center. You will need to take the passes you will find in your arrival pack for access to each of these facilities each time you use them. There are towels provided at the pools and fitness center and you are asked not to take the guest towels in the bathrooms of the cottages to the pools or fitness center. An hourly use fee for the tennis courts is collected at the tennis pro shop. You may bring your own rackets and balls, or you may rent these at the pro shop. You may also check out basketball, badminton, croquet, shuffleboard, and volleyball accessories if you wish to use any of these facilities as well.
